name: The Black Cow
description: A popular Uptown Columbus restaurant serving Southern-inspired comfort food, steaks, burgers, and local favorites in a relaxed setting.

name: Country's Barbecue
description: A Columbus barbecue favorite serving slow-cooked meats, classic Southern sides, and traditional family-style meals in a casual atmosphere.

name: Mellow Mushroom Columbus
description: Serving hand-tossed, baked-on-stone pizzas and calzones, monumental hoagies, and scrumptious salads in a unique setting. Offering over 100 beers.

name: Mabella
description: Serving quality interpretations of classic dishes and daringly ventures into uncharted territories of Italian cuisine. The dynamic menu features a mixture of old and new, satisfying patrons with its wide array of flavors.

name: Saltcellar
description: Located in historic downtown Columbus. Dive into fresh seafood, craft cocktails, and scratch desserts. Columbus’ premier destination for an elevated dining experience.

name: The Loft
description: Dedicated to quality, entertainment, food, and fun for over 30 years, The Loft has become a staple in the community, known for its warm ambiance and exceptional service. Featuring a variety of options, from classic American dishes to innovative culinary

name: Tommy G's
description: A casual, laid-back eatery in Midland Commons (6835 Midland Commons Blvd), Tommy G's has everything you’re craving: pizzas, smash burgers, tacos, pasta, wings, hoagies, salads, and more. And don’t forget to check out the beer wall!

name: The Mix Market
description: The go-to culinary spot in Uptown Columbus, Georgia, where flavors from around the world come together! Whether you're craving mouthwatering pizza, bold Asian dishes, savory sandwiches, fresh salads, or wings with a kick, they’ve got something for everyone.

name: Ruth Ann's Restaurant
description: A longtime Columbus family restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and Southern comfort food in a friendly, casual setting.
